description:
📕 THE HOME HAZARD FILES — 100 field notes on what actually 
starts house fires, and what each fix really costs: 
https://home-hazard-files.netlify.app

Home Hazard reveals the hidden dangers in your home before they become a disaster. From electrical fire hazards and overloaded outlets to the everyday mistakes quietly putting your house at risk — we break down what's dangerous, why it happens, and the simple fixes that keep your family safe. New home safety videos every week. Watch, check your home, and stop a problem before it starts.

⚠️ General home-safety education only — not professional electrical advice. When in doubt, shut off the breaker and call a licensed electrician.

#HomeSafety #ElectricalSafety #FireSafety #HomeHazards #FirePrevention
